p.i: Nec tamen hoc mirum in ea Ecclesia, in qua Cyprianus tyrannicum tumorem, Hieronymus supercilium, Augustinus, & alij Africani Episcopi fumosum seculi typhum, Basilius odiosum fastum antiquitus glisc ere conquesti sunt; in ea, (inquam) decursis plusquam mille Annis, Dominationis superbiam indies ita intumescere, ut Principibus ipsis dominari gestiat. Cui vomicae iam latius excrescenti virus infudit, prae alijs, Bellarminus.

main_text.p: Hunc Romanum Achillem plurimum suspiciendus Episcopus Eliensis, idem nunc Wintoniensis, (quo post renatas literas non extitit ingeniosior aut doctior) Serenis. Regem in acie ducem auspicemque sequutus, iudicij pondere feliciter debellauit: post insigniter eruditus Episcopus Roffensis conglobato omne genus Testium agmine obruit: tandem Reuerendissimus Archiepiscopus Spalatensis solidis insu-

page.notes: Italic is marked only where the scan shows clearly slanted type; the proper names and some phrases may be roman in the print. "Serenis." is read from "Serenifs." with a long s, and "Elien sis" and "Wintonien sis" are one word each, set with a gap. "glisc ere" keeps the printed space. The line ending "insu-" is cut off at the foot of the page and continues on the next page. No page number is printed. The marks "a3" and "per" are the signature and catchword.
